policies.title: Billing
policies.text: Bills are generated on the 1st and due by the 7th of each month.

policies.title: Late payment
policies.text: A small late fee applies after the due date; service pauses 15 days after it.

policies.title: Outage credit
policies.text: If an outage on our side lasts over 24 hours, every affected day is credited automatically.

policies.title: Service level
policies.text: We aim to fix faults within 24 hours, and to tell you about outages before you notice.

policies.title: Refunds
policies.text: Unused prepaid months are refunded within 7 working days if you cancel.

policies.title: Fair usage
policies.text: All home plans are truly unlimited: no data caps and no speed throttling.

policies.title: Lock-in
policies.text: Home plans have no lock-in except Fiber 2 Gig (12 months). Business plans are 12 months.

policies.title: Equipment
policies.text: Routers and extenders stay ours; return them within 15 days of cancelling.

policies.title: Privacy
policies.text: We never sell customer data. Support conversations are kept to serve you and deleted 2 years after you leave.

policies.title: Where your data lives
policies.text: Customer data is stored in your region and never copied to another region's systems.

policies.title: Installation
policies.text: A technician installs, tests speed with you, and leaves only when Wi-Fi works in your main rooms.

policies.title: Deposit
policies.text: No deposit on home plans; business plans need a one-month deposit.

policies.title: Price guarantee
policies.text: Your plan price stays the same for 12 months from activation.

policies.title: Accessibility
policies.text: Large-print bills, screen-reader friendly portal, and phone support for anyone who prefers it.

policies.title: Student offer
policies.text: Students get 20% off Fiber 100 and Fiber 300 with a valid student ID.

policies.title: GDPR
policies.text: EU and UK customers can download or delete their data anytime; our DPO answers within 30 days.

policies.title: Open internet
policies.text: We don't block, throttle or prioritise lawful content.

policies.title: TRAI compliance
policies.text: Plans, speeds and complaint handling follow TRAI rules; escalation to our appellate officer within 30 days.

policies.title: Personal data
policies.text: We follow local personal-data laws such as Singapore's PDPA and Australia's Privacy Act.

policies.title: Licensing
policies.text: We operate under local telecom licences and keep customer data in-region.

policies.title: Personal data
policies.text: We follow local data-protection laws such as Brazil's LGPD.

faqs.q: How do I get {company}?
faqs.a: Pick a plan on our site or tell us in chat, share your address, choose an installation slot, then pay the first month. A technician installs within 48 hours.

faqs.q: Can I use it on my phone?
faqs.a: {company} is home fiber, not a SIM. Your phone connects to the home Wi-Fi like any other device; the app lets you manage it on the go.

faqs.q: Is a router included?
faqs.a: Yes, every plan includes a router at no extra cost; the model depends on the plan.

faqs.q: Can I use my own router?
faqs.a: Yes. Keep ours as the fiber gateway and put yours behind it, or ask us for bridge mode.

faqs.q: How long does installation take?
faqs.a: Usually 48 hours from order to a working connection; the visit itself takes about an hour.

faqs.q: Is there a contract?
faqs.a: Home plans have no lock-in, except Fiber 2 Gig with 12 months. Business plans are 12 months.

faqs.q: Is there a data limit?
faqs.a: No. All plans are unlimited with no throttling.

faqs.q: Do you support IPv6?
faqs.a: Yes, every connection has IPv4 and IPv6.

faqs.q: Will I get the full speed?
faqs.a: Wired speed tests should reach the plan speed; Wi-Fi depends on distance, walls and the device.

faqs.q: How do I hear about outages?
faqs.a: We message you as soon as our network team sees a fault that affects your line, usually before you notice.

faqs.q: When can I reach support?
faqs.a: Chat and WhatsApp-style messaging 24x7; phone support from 8 am to 10 pm local time.

faqs.q: Can I have connections at two homes?
faqs.a: Yes, each address is a separate connection on the same account.

faqs.q: I'm moving to another country. Can I keep my plan?
faqs.a: If we serve that country, we set up a new connection there and close the old one with no fee.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade later?
faqs.a: Anytime. Upgrades are instant and billed pro-rata.

faqs.q: Can I pause while travelling?
faqs.a: Yes, the vacation pause stops billing for 15-90 days once a year.

faqs.q: Do you have referrals?
faqs.a: Yes, you and your friend each get one month free after their installation.

faqs.q: Do you offer business plans?
faqs.a: Yes, Business 500 has symmetrical speed, a static IP and 4-hour fault response.

faqs.q: Which plan is best for gaming?
faqs.a: Fiber 300 or above with Gaming Boost; a wired connection for the console helps most.

faqs.q: Which plan is best for working from home?
faqs.a: Fiber 300 handles several video calls at once; pick Fiber 1000 if you upload large files.

faqs.q: Can I stream 4K?
faqs.a: Yes, Fiber 300 and above handle several 4K streams at once.

faqs.q: How do I test my speed?
faqs.a: Use a wired device and the speed test in the {company} app; Wi-Fi tests show lower numbers.

faqs.q: How do I change the Wi-Fi password?
faqs.a: In the {company} app under Wi-Fi settings, or on the router's admin page.

faqs.q: Can I limit my kids' internet?
faqs.a: Family Shield lets you filter content, set schedules and pause devices.

faqs.q: Can I watch my CCTV remotely?
faqs.a: Yes, add a Static IP and forward the camera port in the app.

faqs.q: Is there a student discount?
faqs.a: Yes, 20% off Fiber 100 and Fiber 300 with a valid student ID.

faqs.q: Will my price go up?
faqs.a: Your price stays the same for 12 months from activation.

faqs.q: Do I pay a deposit?
faqs.a: No deposit on home plans; business plans need a one-month deposit.

faqs.q: How do I cancel?
faqs.a: Tell us in chat; service ends at the end of the billing cycle and you return the router within 15 days.

faqs.q: Can I transfer my connection to someone else?
faqs.a: Yes, ownership transfer at the same address takes one working day and is free.

faqs.q: What's the difference between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz?
faqs.a: 2.4 GHz reaches further; 5 GHz is much faster nearby. Our routers pick the best band automatically.
